The '''Gandeid system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandeid IV]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] once visited the system during his career collecting dental specimens.
